card.statement:
(A pseudo-definition).

Fix $x\in H^{*}(X;k)$. The quantum Steenrod operator $\Sigma_{x}:H^{*}(X;\hat{\Lambda})\to H^{*}_{\mu_{p}}(X;\hat{\Lambda})\cong H^{*}(X;\hat{\Lambda})[\![t,\theta]\!]$ is the $\hat{\Lambda}$ -linear map acting on $x_{0}\in H^{*}(X;k)$ as

(3.9)

$\Sigma_{x}(x_{0})=\sum_{x_{\infty}\in B}\langle x_{0};x_{eq};x_{\infty}\rangle_{0,\alpha}\ x_{\infty}^{\vee}\ z^{\alpha}\in H^{*}_{\mu_{p}}(X;\hat{\Lambda}),$

where $x_{\infty}^{\vee}$ denotes the Poincaré dual of the basis element $x_{\infty}\in B$.

By extending $t,\theta$ -linearly, this can be made into an endomorphism of $H^{*}(X;\hat{\Lambda})[\![t,\theta]\!]$.

The actual construction, outlined in [SW22, Section 4] or [Lee25, Section 2.4], has to go through symplectic enumerative geometry and moduli space of pseudo-holomorphic maps due to the lack of theory providing the required equivariant VFC $[\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{\alpha}]^{vir}_{\mu_{p}}$ to define the correlators $\langle x_{0};x_{eq};x_{\infty}\rangle_{0,\alpha}$.

In the presence of a $T$ -action on $X$, the equivariant generalizations of these operators are given in [Lee23, Definition 2.17]. The operators are indexed by $b\in H^{*}_{T}(X;k)$, and are defined as $\hat{\Lambda}[\![t,\theta]\!]$ -linear endomorphisms $\Sigma_{b}^{T}\in\mathrm{End}\left(H^{*}_{T,loc}(X;\hat{\Lambda})[\![t,\theta]\!]\right)$ of localized equivariant cohomology. The main technical result of [Lee23] can be summarized as follows:

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
